text:
ana: Heads-up 1 I opened a draft PR that reorganizes Dedicated provisioning: adds two autoscale patterns (burst vs steady), a concise SLA routing table, and a short migration callout for Dedicated->Private. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/551
jordan: On it. Which parts need the deepest review? examples, SLA wording, or the migration note?
ana: Sorry typo in my name earlier :-) Focus: autoscale examples (clear config differences), explicit SLA language (which routes are SLA-backed), and the Python SDK snippet that shows graceful fallback on preemption. Also scan for broken links/anchors.
tara: I'll take the SDK snippet. Do you want explicit preemption exception handling and a retry/backoff sample? Customers ask for a pattern.
mike: I sketched a minimal YAML sample for reserved pools to show burst settings:
```yaml
reserved_pool:
  id: critical-prod
  gpu: 4
  autoscale:
    metric: rps
    window: 5m # burst-friendly
    min: 1
    max: 8
    burst_policy: enabled
```
mike: Also added a steady example with 15m window for stable throughput.
devex-bot: docs-ci started for PR #551 1 running spellcheck and lint
docs-ci: lint error in docs/dedicated/provisioning.md line 58 (heading level). Please fix heading style.
nana: Thanks CI, will push a fix for heading levels.
jordan: For SLA wording, current draft says "best-effort with alerts" which is vague. Propose: "SLA-backed routes: 99.9% availability and p95 latency target of X ms; Best-effort routes: no availability guarantee and may be preempted under capacity pressure." Add a table mapping route types to SLA and fallback.
tara: I'll draft that table. Also adding a short migration callout: "Customers migrating to Private must rebind KMS keys and update VPC egress rules; see full migration guide link." Where to put it? top of the provisioning page as a callout?
jordan: Put a 2-line callout on provisioning and link to the full migration guide (stubbed for now).
tara: Will include that and a short Terraform follow-up note. Also updating the Python snippet to show try/except client.errors.PreemptedError and fallback to a smaller model variant.
mike: One tiny ops preference: recommend 5m window + burst_policy for request spikes; 15m window for predictable steady traffic. Call that out in the autoscale section.
nana: Good. Asking reviewers @jordan @tara to review by EOD. Ill merge after CI green.
jordan: Quick nit I left inline about anchor name.
tara: Approved after tweak. I added the preemption example and a bit of backoff pseudocode.
docs-ci: build queued... :hourglass:
docs-ci: build succeeded 1 all checks passed
mike: Should we plan a follow-up to add Terraform snippets and a small CLI quickstart? I can open a tiny PR for TF.
ana: Yes please. This PR will merge first, then TF follow-up. Merging now. Thanks all! :rocket:
